text: {"findings":[{"rule":"H1","where":"Deployment._configureModules","severity":"HIGH","why":"The override calls compliance.removeModule(maxBalanceModule) after the cap is set. With the MaxBalanceModule unbound, canTransfer and mint no longer check any cap, so an investor can receive more than 1000 tokens.","steps":"1. Setup runs _configureModules: setMaxBalance(1000), then removeModule(maxBalanceModule). 2. agent calls token.mint(a1, 1001) (a1 is verified and the country module passes), and it succeeds. 3. Alternatively, a holder transfers 1001 tokens to a verified wallet, and that also succeeds."},{"rule":"H2","where":"Deployment._configureModules (removeModule of MaxBalanceModule)","severity":"HIGH","why":"Wallets a1 and a2 both belong to idA. The shared identity cap is enforced only by MaxBalanceModule, which is unbound, so the two wallets can together hold more than 1000 tokens with no shared limit.","steps":"1. agent mints 800 to a1 and 800 to a2 (both map to idA). 2. Both mints succeed, so idA holds 1600 against a cap of 1000."},{"rule":"H3","where":"Deployment._configureModules (removeModule of MaxBalanceModule)","severity":"MEDIUM","why":"Once the module is unbound, moduleMintAction, moduleTransferAction and moduleBurnAction are no longer called, so the module's _IDBalance records stop tracking real balances. The records drift from actual holdings with every later move.","steps":"1. Setup removes maxBalanceModule. 2. mint(a1, 500) and transfer(b, 200) run, which do not update _IDBalance. 3. getIDBalance(compliance, idA) does not match balanceOf(a1)."}]}
